title: Uzbek Beef Plov (Instant Pot)

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: 500 g Baldo Pirinç rice, or calasparra rice
2–3 lb beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1–2-inch chunks; reserve fat
¼ cup grapeseed oil, or rendered fat from trimmings
1 medium to large onion, sliced into half-moons
½ tsp cumin seed, roughly ground
3 Tbsp barberries, sour cherries or currants, optional

steps: Render the beef trimmings for about 15–30 minutes on the slow-cooker setting. Discard the rendered bits and add oil as needed to make about ¼ cup total. Rinse rice until water runs clear and leave in a strainer.
Select sauté on high. When oil shimmers, optionally fry the small onion for a couple of minutes, then discard it. Sauté sliced onion until translucent and lightly brown at the edges.
Move onions aside and sear the beef in the middle of the pot until golden outside. Add carrot, cumin, water, salt and dried chiles; stir.
Select Meat/Stew for 15 minutes. Rest naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release the remaining pressure. Taste the broth for salt.
Sprinkle in optional berries. Add rice in an even layer without stirring and bury the garlic head cut-side down. Make 4–5 holes around the center with a long utensil handle.
Pressure cook on high for 12 minutes, rest naturally for 10 minutes and quick-release remaining pressure. Fluff rice, mound it, cover and rest another 20 minutes.
